entries.title: I Corinthians 13:1
segments: If I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am become sounding brass, or a clanging cymbal.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:2
segments: And if I have [the gift of] prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:3
segments: And if I bestow all my goods to feed [the poor], and if I give my body to be burned, but have not love, it profiteth me nothing.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:4
segments: Love suffereth long, [and] is kind; love envieth not; love vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:5
segments: doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not its own, is not provoked, taketh not account of evil;

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:6
segments: rejoiceth not in unrighteousness, but rejoiceth with the truth;

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:7
segments: beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:8
segments: Love never faileth: but whether [there be] prophecies, they shall be done away; whether [there be] tongues, they shall cease; whether [there be] knowledge, it shall be done away.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:9
segments: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part;

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:10
segments: but when that which is perfect is come, that which is in part shall be done away.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:11
segments: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child: now that I am become a man, I have put away childish things.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:12
segments: For now we see in a mirror, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know fully even as also I was fully known.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:13
segments: But now abideth faith, hope, love, these three; and the greatest of these is love.
